Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malicious burning, and an accidental fire from a forgotten stove lacks malice; the team note is wrong because arson is itself a common-law felony, so the grade of the offense doesn't gate it.

Q9000.reason: General Assembly resolutions are non-binding and act as a material source that may evidence or enunciate customary law, not as a binding source or conclusive proof of custom.

Q9002.reason: The grantor's power to 're-enter' on breach, rather than an automatic reversion, makes this a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent; the team note's automatic-termination reading describes a determinable fee.
